out_of_scope: True token counting from Claude Code API (no hook API for session token metadata today)
Spec branching UI / tree navigation (Pi's /tree) — requires Claude Code TUI investment
Session export / share to HTML or gist — separate initiative
lean --flag for setup-bootstrap (setup-bootstrap already enforces 60-80 line target; this gap is already addressed)
assumptions: wc -c and wc -l produce consistent output on macOS (BSD) and Linux (GNU) after tr -d ' ' normalization
The pipe-separated $files list in session state is the canonical unique-file tracker
hook-io.sh load/save uses key=value format extensible with new fields; existing readers ignore unknown fields
Context-engineering footprint output is visible in Claude Code chat (not silenced)
Version suffix -vN is sortable numerically; ls -v or sort -V handles v2 < v3 < v10
risks: R1: wc -c on large incidental files inflates bytes_read — mitigated by 100k per-file cap with flag
R2: Spec versioning false-fire on similar slug — mitigated by exact date+slug match requirement
R3: hook-io.sh extension breaks existing readers — mitigated by initializing new fields with 0 defaults
R4: Footprint output adds Phase 0 noise — mitigated by collapsible section header format
R5: context-report slow on many files — mitigated by limiting to active tech stack globs only
